info.title: CSI CRM Orchestrator
info.description: Single entry point for CSI CRM questions. Internally plans, calls the quantitative (NL→DAX) and qualitative (RAG) backends in parallel, and returns ONE unified Thai answer. The caller only needs to pass the user's question verbatim and return the 'answer' field unchanged.

post.summary: Answer a CSI CRM question (handles everything internally)
post.description: Send the user's question VERBATIM. Returns a single unified Thai answer in 'answer'. Do NOT pre-classify, rewrite, or post-process — just relay the question in and the 'answer' out.

q.description: The user's question, VERBATIM (Thai or English). Do not edit.

answer.description: The final unified Thai answer. Return this to the user EXACTLY as given.

quant.description: Quant trace (dax, data, value, measure, top_accounts, advisory, error)

plan.description: The quant_q / qual_q the orchestrator composed
